payload.summary: WA-endorsed review debt: recording eight reviews is deferred; accepted ceiling is 0.95
payload.detail: REVALIDATED 2026-10-23 at df1e07db04. Preserve shipped cohort separation and recorded 0.95 debt ceiling. Eight review recordings are explicitly deferred; this audit does not write reviews, approve a ceiling change or assert the release gate passes. Source inspection only; no fresh application/provider execution or clinical sign-off. Evidence: docs/decisions/2026-10-22-wa-endorsed-review-gate.md; docs/outstanding-issues-inbox/27096a2e-3437-48c1-8b94-bc04eb676b7e.json. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-10-23: option (a) shipped in PR #3770 (wa_endorsed_unreviewed_rate on its own line, strict 0.25 for the rest, owner-accepted waiver ceiling 0.95). For (b) the owner reviewed and signed off all 8 most-surfaced documents on 2026-10-22 18:47Z, but recording them in the live database was DEFERRED by the owner on 2026-10-23 10:21Z. Nothing has been written. The recording script is ready (project file source-reviews/record-8-reviews-2026-10-22.sql; the owner runs it in the Supabase SQL editor, step 1 check then step 2). NEXT ACTION after recording: propose lowering the 0.95 ceiling to about 0.5. PRIOR DETAIL: Release pilot on 92d37ba (10 golden cases, top 10, 96 slots; report retrieval-quality-2026-10-22T08-53-39-443Z) measured 0.9271. Cause: all 89 flagged slots are WA service PDFs that migration 20260926170000 (PR #3111, owner-approved) moved from an import-stamped locally_reviewed to unverified with evidence basis wa_document_control_endorsement. Retrieval order did not change. eval-quality topResultGovernanceCounts counts every unverified slot as review-required whatever its basis. Not the cause: PR #3746 (not in 92d37ba and writes no statuses), and lapsed review dates (review_due is 17 of 96, 0.18, down from 31 of 113 in July). The comparison is also not like for like: July was top 5 over 23 cases, the gate now counts top 10, and the pilot is a 10-case subset. Next action: owner decides between (a) splitting only the wa_document_control_endorsement cohort into its own line with its own blocking, owner-accepted, expiring debt ceiling that tightens as reviews land (it stays review debt, not resolved), while the existing gate keeps counting review_due and every other unverified basis (pilot figure 0.18 on that line), with a decision record and waiver update, and (b) owner review of the most-surfaced documents: Clozapine (CAMHS), Clozapine Prescribing (AKG), Clozapine Management by GP (NMHS, also review_due), Agitation and Arousal (EMHS, AKG, FSH), Patient Safety Plan (AKG) and Patient Property (AKG) account for 46 of the 89 slots. Recommended: both, with (b) driving the endorsed cohort's ceiling down. No paid run is needed to decide; recompute from the existing pilot JSON.
